notes.title: Offworld Trading Company 1.23.40207 Update Notes
notes.notes:
Mohawk Games and Stardock are pleased to announce a new update for Offworld Trading Company. This new patch contains the following changes:

[list]
[*] Fixed lobby chat to show "[AI Player]" team change instead of "Unknown"
[*] Direct connection attempt if NAT fails, kick player from lobby (with informational popup) if both fail so game doesn't hang on start
[*] Fix for doubled observer text
[*] Toggle AI icon appropriately when players join/leave AI slots
[*] Fixed an issue where restore code prevented players from building multiple times on a tile
[*] Fixed Show ELO option
[*] Temporarily removed PIRATE_HIT_TARGET audio (too harsh and unclear)
[*] No longer send game starting message until all clients are connected to server
[*] Improved leave lobby if game fails to start so failed lobby can get cleaned up
[*] Highlight tiles adjacent to HQ if the only tiles with adjacency bonuses are remote
[*] Re-sort leaderboards after adding the player's new score
[*] Fix for player messages showing up as observer messages after the game ends
[*] Extra checks and logging at game start added
[*] Only increment global hack counters when hacks finish
[*] Restore robotic adjacency in tutorial 1
[*] Fix for matches not starting properly on first attempts
[*] Fix for infinite map challenge progress incorrectly overwriting existing progress
[*] Fix for remote buildings not sharing resources properly
[*] Fix for event state help formatting
[*] Looser conditions for transferring resources to buildings in group
[*] Fix for ranked matches not always starting properly
[*] Fix for campaign unlocks not working consistently on Epic
[*] Correcting Russian singular/plural expressions with feedback from the OW discord
[*] Fix for null reference in server logs
[/list]

notes.title: Offworld Trading Company 1.23.35836 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Mohawk Games and Stardock are pleased to announce the release of version 1.23.35836 of Offworld Trading Company today!

[b]Changes include the following:[/b]

[h2]Features[/h2]
+ Crossplay between Steam and Epic Games Store owners is now enabled for multiplayer games, as well as on the leaderboards for daily changes and infinite map challenges.

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
+ Improved performance.
+ Fixed some terrain icon issues.
+ Fix for Liquid Batteries tooltip, special building cycling in replays
+ Fixed an issue where some players were unable to install if they had a - in the path name
+ Fixed an issue where auctions sometimes didn't trigger in the campaign
+ Players marked as timed out while still being connected (AI player starts playing with you bug)
+ Change clients to ping more consistently (disconnects in MP bug)
+ Can't start a game if anyone other than the host is an observer
+ AI Players option disabled when Random Location is selected
+ Allow layout to recalculate with string length compares (to avoid weird formatting issues)
+ Restore chat scroll to bottom and message recycling
+ Reduce network traffic for lobbies
+ Fix for too many query stat requests
+ Fixed a bug that was keeping campaign and scenarios progress from being saved
+ Observer fixes and clearer lobby connection warnings
+ Leaderboard fixes (hide missing avatars, actually load data)

[h2]UI[/h2]
+ More Granular volume sliders.
+ UI optimization.
+ Colorized net revenue text for the import buttons.

notes.title: Offworld Trading Company - April Update
notes.notes:
Greetings, Offworld fans!

We've released a small patch for the game today that addresses a few of the issues the community has brought to our attention recently. Now, instead of twiddling your thumbs while you look for a match, you'll be able to play a skirmish while you wait! We also removed a few maps that came up during the Daily Challenge that weren't supposed to be there - whoops. Check out the full change notes below.

See you online!

[h1]Change Notes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed Europa showing up in the Daily Challenge
[*] Skirmish matches for ranked queues are now available in the free client
[*] Added tooltip to help explain some free client restrictions
[*] Fixed bug where the scenario mod would unload during the Market Corrections DLC check.
[/list]

notes.title: v1.21 update brings additional language support for Offworld Trading Company base game and DLC
notes.notes:
[h1][b]We've updated so that all of our released languages are now fully supported![/b][/h1]
[b]Enjoy the full range of dialogue and story in Offworld Trading Company[/b]
View the complete list of updates in the changelog below

We want everyone to be able to experience and enjoy all of the story, dialogue, and nuances in Offworld Trading Company and all of its DLC. We've updated support for the following languages so that the translations now extend to all aspects of the game:
[list]
[*] Simplified Chinese
[*] German
[*] Brazilian Portuguese
[*] Polish
[*] Korean
[*] Spanish
[*] French
[*] Russian
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28974/416c1142a38414dfa197f35e51441ac8c594dd7c.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28974/36a2dd498dd3b03725d862481cc49627f9c8c288.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28974/530e5190542e6141b14c30d9b04fdde27b42b40b.jpg[/img]
_____________________________________________________________

[h1][b]What is Offworld Trading Company?[/b][/h1]

Take on the role of entrepreneur and travel to Mars for an economic showdown against other companies in Offworld Trading Company! Buy out your competition and take control of the Martian market in a strategy game where money, not military force, is your greatest weapon. The real-time, player-driven market is the foundation of the game, allowing you to buy
and sell resources and materials - even the food and water that the colonists need to survive. Build up enough capital and gain access to the lucrative offworld markets so that you can buy out your rivals and claim the Martian economy for yourself.

_____________________________________________________________

[h1][b]v1.21.24522 Changelog[/b][/h1]
[b]General[/b]
Localization has been improved for the following languages:
[list]
[*] French
[*] German
[*] Spanish
[*] Korean
[*] Polish
[*] Brazilian Portuguese
[*] Russian
[*] Simplified Chinese
[/list]

[b]Balance[/b]
[list]
[*] Elite Pleasure Domes now take the same entertainment share as a standard Pleasure Dome
[*] Elite Headquarters reverted to use the same amount of steel as other factions
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Scientist Nuclear Plants now have the same cost and power production as other factions
[*] Fixed an issue with the resume button on the Infinite Map Challenge
[*] Ticker Text now resets correctly
[/list]

notes.title: Offworld Trading Company 1.20.20465 Update
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7872729/5951b5ec9e3aea20b72cb0214e2c5eebc7c614aa.png[/img]

[h1]General[/h1]
[list][*]Tutorials have been updated[*]Players can now see their Masquerade name while when playing in Masquerade mode[*]Some colony classes have had their resource price minimums lowered. In the Daily Challenge mode the best move was sometimes just throwing down a large number of mines or quarries on an easy to access resource, and because the resource would never drop below $30 a player could just sell that one resource until they had won. This change to address that situation and encourage more interesting strategies.[*]Increased precision of the server game timer.[/list]

[h1]Balance[/h1]
As expressed by the community recently, extra claims can be extremely powerful. In fact, this reward for founding late was so strong that many players would only found without it in the most dire of circumstances. Early claims are being adjusted so that in games of 4 players or less everyone will receive an extra claim eventually.[list][*]Last four players to found now all receive a free claim (last to found on HQ2, then HQ3, HQ4, HQ5) regardless of number of players in the game[/list]

Several small changes are being made to Black Market items to add consistency and bring costs in line with the power each item brings. Spies and Holograms will now have a cooldown, preventing a player with an early lead from taking them all cheaply to get a significant advantage. Meanwhile, Return a Claim and Core Samples have had their cooldowns reduced to encourage their use.[list][*]Return a Claim Black Market item can now be purchased when in D Debt[*]Changed Black Market cooldown for Bribe a Claim to 90 seconds (up from 60)[*]Changed Black Market cooldown for Holograms, Spies, Return a Claim, and Core Sample to 30 seconds. [*]Pirates now steal 200 resources[*]Pirates and Magnetic Storms are more likely to appear[/list]

Patents are receiving some small adjustments, focused on making energy slightly more accessible and bringing Transparent Aluminum’s power down.[list][*]Energy Vault now produces 2 backup Energy (up from 1)[*]Transparent Aluminum now costs 60 chems (up from 40)[*]Perpetual Motion now costs 40 chems (down from 60)[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list][*]Nomads now receive the correct Black Market time when founding[*]Infinite Challenge Leaderboard now properly updates when played from the Ranked Queue[*]Geothermal Borehole Auctions will no longer occur on maps where no Geothermal Vents are present[*]Overflow bug and formatting fixed for very large amounts of cash[*]Players can once again see number of players in FFA queue while in the 1v1 queue[*]Fixed an error with “Infinite Win (Io)” Achievement[*]Fixed border color artifacts on Medium and Low Rendering Quality[/list]

notes.title: Announcing the Release of Offworld Trading Company on 04.28.2016!
notes.notes:
[b]The next great strategy game from Civilization IV designer Soren Johnson
Bankrupt your friends in the economic strategy game, Offworld Trading Company[/b]

[b]Releasing on 04.28.2016![/b]  

Grab your briefcases and ready your billfolds, the time for all-out corporate warfare has finally arrived! Hire pirates to raid your enemies' businesses, corner the market on your resources of choice, and turn your friends into frenemies in this fast-paced economic RTS!  
 
[b]Win your fight with wit, not weapons[/b]
The Martian market is a battlefield where your money, wits, and business savvy win the wars. Race against your opponents to control the stock market and drive their businesses into the ground.  
  
[b]Experience new adventure in every game[/b]
Every time you play Offworld, it's a new experience! Since the gameplay is market-driven and changes each time, no two games will ever be the same. 
  
[b]Manipulate the Market[/b]
No one ever said that corporate war was fair. Sneak in some underhanded attacks against your opponents by hiring pirates from the black market to steal their hard-earned goods, or send a spy in with a device to trigger an Electro Magnetic Pulse to disrupt their business for a short time.
  
[b]Exciting Daily Challenges[/b]
Try our daily challenges and test your mettle against other players to try and get the highest score! Take a look at the scoreboard and watch the leaders' replay videos to check out their strategies. 
  
Learn about Mars' Corporations in the Campaign
Four big businesses are vying for all of the resources and control on Mars. Learn about what brought them there and how they intend to drive their competition into the ground and come out on top.    

[b]Offworld Trading Company will be releasing on 04.28.2016![/b]
 If you haven't already, check out our Early Access version on [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/271240/]Steam[/url] or [url=http://www.offworldgame.com/store]Stardock[/url]. 
 For more information, visit [url=http://www.offworldgame.com]www.offworldgame.com[/url]
